summaries.Romania: Romania faces an energy crisis as the Danube hits historic lows, forcing emergency measures including nuclear plant interventions and mandatory consumption cuts, while political tensions escalate around presidential suspension attempts and EU funding disputes.
summaries.Healthcare: FDA approves Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine and Takeda's novel narcolepsy treatment as healthcare systems expand AI integration, while payers navigate rising ACA premiums and providers implement new care delivery models.
summaries.Tech: Major AI leadership shifts at Google and departures from OpenAI highlight industry turbulence, while Apple faces security vulnerabilities in iCloud Private Relay and legal battles over trade secrets, and new robotaxi and foldable phone launches reshape consumer technology.

items.line: Romania's Danube river hits historic lows (1,400 m³/s), threatening nuclear power operations and forcing emergency interventions that demonstrate the country's energy infrastructure fragility.

items.title: FDA approves Moderna’s mRNA flu vaccine, the first to use the technology
items.snippet: The FDA has approved Moderna’s influenza vaccine, the first licensed flu shot made using messenger RNA technology.
items.line: Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine approval represents a breakthrough in applying mRNA technology beyond COVID, potentially accelerating development of other mRNA-based immunizations.

items.title: OpenAI asks for Apple’s trade secrets lawsuit to be dismissed, says it was filed without ‘adequate investigation’
items.snippet:
The ongoing Apple-OpenAI lawsuit of alleged trade secrets theft continues, with OpenAI today filing a motion to have the case dismissed by a federal judge. OpenAI said Apple’s complaint was “filed without adequate investigation” and framed “ordinary conduct” out of context.

items.line: OpenAI's dismissal motion in Apple's trade secrets lawsuit claims allegations are 'meritless' and mischaracterize ordinary business conduct, setting up a critical legal battle.

items.title: iCloud Private Relay might be leaking your real IP address, researchers say
items.snippet: Security researchers have discovered a problem with Apple’s iCloud Private Relay service. While the feature is meant to protect your real IP address, it might actually be leaking it to websites.
items.line: Security researchers confirm iCloud Private Relay can leak users' real IP addresses to websites using passkeys, undermining Apple's core privacy promise.

items.title: Jeff Dean and other top AI researchers are leaving Google to launch their own startup
items.snippet: The legendary Google executive is joined by other outgoing Google execs in a joint mission to use AI to push forward the process of scientific discovery.
items.line: Jeff Dean and top Google AI researchers departing to launch a scientific discovery-focused startup signals brain drain from major tech companies and growing AI talent fragmentation.

items.title: Google just announced a major shakeup of its top AI leadership
items.snippet: Google is making some significant AI leadership changes, including a major shift for Google DeepMind leader Demis Hassabis. Hassabis will become the chair of Google DeepMind and the chief scientist at Alphabet, CEO Sundar Pichai announced on Wednesday. Hassabis will continue to lead Alphabet's Isomo
items.line: Google's major AI leadership reshuffle—with Demis Hassabis stepping back as DeepMind CEO—reflects institutional shifts as the company consolidates AI strategy under new structure.

items.title: Guvernul aprobă astăzi măsurile care pot fi luate în caz de urgenţă energetică: cine poate fi deconectat de la sistem
items.snippet: Guvernul aprobă în ședința de astăzi planul de pregătire pentru riscuri în domeniul energiei electrice, inițiat de Ministerul Energiei. Acesta stabilește regulile de acțiune în situații extreme, cum ar fi seceta, o situaţie precum cea din prezent (când avem deja declarată situaţie de alertă energeti
items.line: Government energy emergency plan establishes rules for potential industrial disconnections and reduction measures, signaling preparation for critical grid scenarios.

items.title: Cât anticipează ministrul Finanțelor că va fi creşterea economică în acest an. „Depinde de evoluţia în trimestrele III şi IV”
items.snippet: Scenariul de bază al Guvernului rămâne o creştere economică de 0,1% în acest an, însă atingerea acestei ţinte depinde de evoluţia economiei în trimestrele III şi IV, iar procesul de dezinflaţie este aşteptat să înceapă în perioada august-septembrie, susţine ministrul Finanţelor, Alexandru Nazare.
items.line: Romania's 2026 growth forecast remains at 0.1%, with recovery dependent on Q3-Q4 performance and starting disinflation expected in August-September.

items.title: STAT+: Takeda’s narcolepsy drug approved by the FDA, seen as a boon for new class of treatments
items.snippet: The FDA approved a novel type of treatment for narcolepsy made by Takeda, backing a new drug class that scientists hope can be used to treat other conditions.
items.line: FDA's approval of Takeda's novel narcolepsy treatment validates a new drug class that could extend to treating other neurological conditions.

items.title: CVS enhances supports for patients taking GLP-1s
items.snippet: CVS Health is raising its guidance for the year as it blew past Wall Street analysts' expectations in the second quarter.
items.line: CVS Health's enhanced GLP-1 support and raised 2026 guidance reflect growing market demand for weight management integration into healthcare delivery.

items.title: Hinge Health to acquire Cylinder Health in a $105M deal to expand into gastrointestinal care
items.snippet: Hinge Health raised its full-year revenue and profitability expectations for the remainder of 2026 as the company reported another strong quarter and further expands its business beyond muscle and joint pain.
items.line: Hinge Health's $105M Cylinder Health acquisition expands digital therapeutics beyond musculoskeletal care into gastrointestinal conditions.

items.title: Meta launches Muse Code, an AI agent for large code bases
items.snippet: Meta expanded its AI coding offerings with a new agent that, it promises, can handle complex tasks with complex software.
items.line: Meta's new Muse Code AI agent handles complex software engineering tasks across large repositories, intensifying competition in AI-assisted development tools.
